name: @koment/opencode-koment
description: OpenCode plugin for koment: enforce the no-inline-comment policy through the koment MCP server. Install with `opencode plugin install @koment/opencode-koment`.
author: koment-dev

scripts.postinstall:
node -e "import('node:child_process').then(({execSync}) => { try { execSync('command -v koment', {stdio: 'ignore'}); } catch { console.warn('
koment: the `koment` binary was not found on PATH.
  Install with: https://github.com/koment-dev/koment/releases
  The plugin will load, but the session-end dispose hook (koment check, comments check, agents check)
  requires the binary. The pre-tool MCP gate runs without it.
'); } })"
